changes_made.explanation: Removed BM-25 and dense retrieval models as they are not generation models but retrieval components. Consolidated output descriptions into a single clear statement. Normalized dataset name variations.
No changes needed - Entity-F1 and BLEU are correctly identified as the automatic evaluation metrics used in the paper.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper only uses LLMs (T5) for generation, not for evaluation.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on task-oriented dialogue generation using a query-driven approach. It uses standard automatic metrics (Entity-F1 and BLEU) but does not include human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The main contributions are well-aligned with NLG evaluation.
